search_strategy: Code-first, then exhaustive corpus sweep. Read the entire tinker_trainer.py/fireworks_trainer.py/config.py/types.py before touching any external source (steps 1-14). Checked Gitea issues (title search only, mostly upstream noise), then the wiki (full page listing + full-text search, found nothing — correctly inferred wiki comments aren't indexed and fetched all 114 pages' raw JSON with comments, still nothing), then mail (IMAP subject list + full-text search, one weak hit), before landing on Mattermost. Once in Mattermost, dumped every channel's full post history to /tmp/chat/*.txt (step 26) and iterated many overlapping grep sweeps: broad ('ledger', 'reasons'), then narrower keyword sets ('cosine|decay|base_lr|learning rate|learning_rate' for LR; 'padded|save_checkpoint|CheckpointInfo|loss_history|total_steps|batches_completed' for checkpoints; 'TEMPLATE|template'; 'min_lr_ratio|MIN_LR_RATIO|effective_warmup|warmup|...'), each time following up by `sed -n` on the surrounding lines of a hit to read the full exchange rather than trusting the single grepped line. Also checked Gitea branches (feature/tinker, nikolai/finetuning-client) for prior parked work. This recovered essentially the entire r1 design (checkpoint identity, CHECKPOINT_REASONS/canonical_reasons, dedup-by-name) and the entire r2 LR schedule formula including both herring/reversal pairs. The one systematic gap: every LR-specific grep sweep was built around the words cosine/decay/base_lr/learning_rate, so a remark phrased without any of them (g11.r2.l10, about a Python keyword-only parameter on PR 663) was never found — and #code-review was grepped only for 'reasons'-cluster terms restricted to the Mar-Apr range, never for the late-May date range or for '663'. A handful of r1 remarks phrased outside the grepped vocabulary (l2, l5, l9, l11, l13, l14, l19) were likewise never surfaced, but every one of those facts still passed because another remark in the same requirement carried equivalent content.
end_reason: Clean, near-complete success (reward 0.8889, one fact lost of nine). Commit 5cfba24 merged to main, CI run 14 green, release deployed and health-checked (transcript lines 8768, 8819). Every LR-related grep the agent ran was keyed to cosine/decay/base_lr/learning_rate vocabulary, none of which appear in l10's text, and #code-review was never dumped or grepped outside the Mar-Apr 'reasons' clusters. The shipped `learning_rate_at` signature is `min_lr_ratio: float = MIN_LR_RATIO` (line 5707) with no leading `*`, so it graded POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD instead of KEYWORD_ONLY — every other value the function computes (MIN_LR_RATIO=0.1, the ramp, lr(5)=8.5e-05, lr(7)=5.5e-05, lr(10)=1e-05, the constant per-step gaps, the min_lr_ratio=0.5/0.0 special cases) is exact.
